core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mikal corresponds to the Arabic form ميكال (Arabic مِيكَال (Mīkāl), a Qur'anic variant of مِيكَائِيل). Its core sense is michael; an archangel's name. Mikal is Arabic مِيكَال (Mīkāl), a Qur'anic variant form of مِيكَائِيل (Mīkāʾīl), the archangel Michael. The source gloss 'Who is like God?' is the traditional Hebrew etymology and is broadly consistent.
